# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `synergielocsynergieloc` MCP server pointing at Synergieloc's hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint (`https://synergieloc.fr/mcp/compte`).
- Auth uses OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and dynamic client registration — no client ID to configure.
- Logo: Synergieloc's hosted icon URL; no image file is committed because synergieloc.fr was unreachable when the plugin was added.
